title: The Legislative Process
description: The legislative process — the bill-to-law workflow — runs: the drafting (the policy — the legal language; the counsel — the expert), the introduction (the sponsored — the referred to committee), the committee (the hearings — the public; the markup — the amended; the reported), the floor (the debated — the amended; the voted), the second chamber (the concurred — the conferenced where differing), the executive (the signed — the vetoed; the overridden — the supermajority), and the implementation (the regulated — the administered). The disciplines: the deliberation (the real — the read), the transparency (the open — the recorded), and the patience (the slow — the considered). The pathologies: the omnibus (the unread — the passed), the riders (the attached — the unrelated), and the gridlock (the stalled). The principle: the laws made well — the deliberated, the transparent, the constitutional.
key_points: Draft, introduce, committee, floor, second chamber, executive, implement
how_it_works: Draft expertly, hear publicly, mark up openly, debate fully, vote accountably, implement faithfully.

title: The Regulatory Rulemaking Process
description: Rulemaking — the notice-and-comment workflow (the US APA model) — runs: the authorization (the statute — the delegated), the agenda (the published — the unified agenda), the proposal (the NPRM — the published; the comments — the solicited), the analysis (the cost-benefit — the OIRA-reviewed; the alternatives — the considered), the final (the comments — the answered; the rule — the published with the basis), and the review (the judicial — the arbitrary-and-capricious; the congressional — the CRA). The disciplines: the participation (the genuine — the considered), the evidence (the record — the supporting), and the proportionality (the burden — the fitting). The pathologies: the ossification (the years — the paralyzed), the capture (the commenters — the regulated), and the midnight (the rushed — the outgoing). The principle: the rules made fairly — the authorized, the participatory, the evidenced.
key_points: NPRM; public comment solicited and answered
how_it_works: Propose publicly, analyze costs/benefits, consider comments, publish with reasons, accept review.

title: The Budget Cycle
description: The budget cycle — the annual resource workflow — runs: the formulation (the executive’s — the agencies’ requests; the OMB — the reviewed; the president’s — the proposed), the legislative (the budget resolution — the framed; the appropriations — the 12 bills; the authorized — the appropriated), the execution (the apportioned — the spent; the impounded — the not), the audit (the GAO — the reviewed), and the cycle (the continuing resolutions — the when stalled; the shutdowns — the when failed). The disciplines: the transparency (the open — the citizen’s guide), the discipline (the PAYGO — the offset; the debt — the managed), and the performance (the informed — the outcomes). The pathologies: the brinkmanship (the shutdowns), the earmarks (the directed — the debated), and the opacity (the incomprehensible). The principle: the budget is the policy in numbers — the formulated openly, the appropriated deliberatively, the executed faithfully.
how_it_works: Formulate via agencies, propose, resolve and appropriate, execute, audit, repeat.

title: Public Procurement: The Buying Workflow
description: Public procurement — the government’s buying (the 10–15% of GDP) — runs: the planning (the needs — the specified; the market — the researched), the solicitation (the competed — the openly; the sealed bids — the fair), the evaluation (the criteria — the published; the scored — the objectively; the value — the best, not the cheapest), the award (the announced — the debriefed losers; the protested — the fairly), the contract (the managed — the performance; the variations — the controlled), and the closeout (the accepted — the lessons). The disciplines: the competition (the genuine), the integrity (the corruption — the prevented; the debarred — the excluded), and the value (the lifecycle — the total cost). The pathologies: the bid-rigging (the colluded), the gold-plating (the overspecified), and the change-order (the exploited). The principle: the public buys well — the competed openly, the evaluated fairly, the managed actively.
how_it_works: Plan needs, solicit openly, evaluate on published criteria, award transparently, manage performance.

title: Service Delivery Design
description: Service delivery — the citizen’s experience — designs: the user research (the needs — the studied; the journeys — the mapped), the standards (the promised — the citizen’s charters; the measured), the channels (the digital — the default; the phone — the human; the in-person — the accessible; the assisted — the included), the once-only (the data — the reused; the asked — the never twice), and the feedback (the collected — the acted-on; the published). The disciplines: the end-to-end (the life events — the designed around), the inclusion (the offline — the served), and the continuous (the improved — the measured). The failures: the agency-centric (the designed for the bureaucracy), and the digital-only (the excluded). The principle: the services designed for the citizen — the researched, the standardized, the inclusive.
how_it_works: Research users, map journeys, set standards, deliver omnichannel, collect feedback, improve.

title: Benefits Delivery Systems
description: Benefits delivery — the welfare machinery — runs: the eligibility (the determined — the accurately; the simplified — the take-up), the application (the easy — the assisted; the digital — the plus), the verification (the proportionate — the risk-based; the data-matched — the automatic), the payment (the timely — the accurate; the dignified), the review (the periodic — the light-touch; the changes — the reported easily), and the appeal (the accessible — the fair; the timely). The disciplines: the take-up (the maximized — the unclaimed minimized), the accuracy (the official error — the minimized; the fraud — the proportionate), and the dignity (the designed — the respectful). The failures: the hostile (the deterring — the by-design), and the error (the overpaid — the clawed-back cruelly). The principle: the benefits delivered — the accurately, the timely, the dignified.
how_it_works: Simplify eligibility, assist applications, verify proportionately, pay timely, review lightly, hear appeals.

title: Emergency Management: The Cycle
description: Emergency management — the comprehensive cycle (FEMA model) — runs: the mitigation (the prevented — the building codes; the reduced — the floodplains), the preparedness (the planned — the exercised; the stockpiled), the response (the activated — the ICS; the coordinated — the multi-agency), and the recovery (the rebuilt — the better; the aided — the individuals, the publics). The systems: the incident command (the standardized — the NIMS; the interoperable), the communications (the alerted — the WEA; the informed — the continuously), and the declarations (the escalated — the local to the national; the funded). The disciplines: the whole-community (the included — the vulnerable prioritized), the exercised (the drilled — the regularly), and the learned (the after-actioned). The principle: the emergencies managed comprehensively — the mitigated, the prepared, the responded, the recovered better.
how_it_works: Mitigate risks, prepare and exercise, respond via ICS, recover with improvement, learn always.

title: The Diplomatic Workflow
description: Diplomacy — the state’s external work — runs: the policy (the formulated — the interests defined; the interagency — the coordinated), the bilateral (the negotiated — the treaties; the managed — the daily), the multilateral (the represented — the UN, the alliances; the coalitioned), the consular (the citizens — the protected abroad; the visas — the managed), and the crisis (the responded — the evacuated; the negotiated — the de-escalated). The disciplines: the professionalism (the career — the trained), the coherence (the one-voice — the coordinated), and the ethics (the interests — the pursued; the values — the represented). The tools: the summits (the conducted), the sanctions (the leveraged — the multilateralized), and the aid (the given — the strategically). The principle: the diplomacy serves the national interest — the professional, the coherent, the values-aware.
how_it_works: Formulate policy, negotiate bilaterally, coalition multilaterally, protect citizens, manage crises.

title: Policy Evaluation Workflows
description: Policy evaluation — the learning workflow — runs: the commissioning (the independent — the funded; the questions — the stakeholders’), the design (the appropriate — the RCTs where possible; the quasi — the theory-based where apt), the data (the administrative — the linked; the collected — the baselined), the analysis (the rigorous — the limitations stated), the reporting (the public — the accessible; the recommendations — the actionable), and the use (the decisions — the informed; the sunset — the evidenced). The disciplines: the independence (the credible), the timeliness (the decision-relevant), and the use (the tracked — the findings applied). The institutions: the evaluation units (the embedded), the what-works (the clearinghouses), and the audit (the performance). The principle: the evaluated policy learns — the independent, the rigorous, the used.
how_it_works: Commission independently, design appropriately, analyze rigorously, report publicly, track use.

title: The Legislative Oversight Workflow
description: Legislative oversight — the checking workflow — runs: the hearings (the scheduled — the topical; the witnesses — the sworn), the investigations (the authorized — the resourced; the bipartisan — the credible), the questions (the written — the answered; the oral — the pressed), the reports (the published — the recommendations), and the follow-up (the implemented — the tracked; the re-heard — the if not). The disciplines: the seriousness (the substantive — the not the theatrical), the bipartisanship (the credible), and the persistence (the followed-up). The powers: the subpoena (the compelled), the contempt (the enforced — the rarely), and the purse (the leveraged). The principle: the overseen executive answers — the investigated seriously, the followed-up persistently.
how_it_works: Hear regularly, investigate credibly, report publicly, follow up persistently.

title: Tax Administration Workflows
description: Tax administration — the revenue machinery — runs: the registration (the taxpayers — the identified), the filing (the simplified — the pre-filled where possible; the digital), the assessment (the verified — the risk-based audits), the collection (the enforced — the proportionate; the debts — the managed), the service (the assisted — the educated; the rulings — the certain), and the appeals (the independent — the fair). The disciplines: the voluntary compliance (the maximized — the easy to comply; the hard to evade), the fairness (the applied — the equally), and the digital (the transformed). The measures: the tax gap (the estimated — the closed), and the burden (the minimized — the compliant). The principle: the taxes collected — the fairly, the efficiently, the with service.
core_principles: Easy to comply, hard to evade
how_it_works: Simplify filing, assist taxpayers, audit by risk, enforce proportionately, hear appeals fairly.

title: The Census and Statistics Workflow
description: Official statistics — the state’s facts — are produced: the census (the decennial — the enumerated; the protected — the confidential; the used — the apportioned, the funded), the surveys (the continuous — the labor force, the household — the sampled rigorously), the administrative (the linked — the registers; the integrated), and the dissemination (the open — the accessible; the impartial — the pre-announced). The principles: the independence (the professional — the insulated from politics), the confidentiality (the trusted — the guaranteed), and the quality (the methodological — the transparent). The threats: the politicization (the resisted), the underfunding (the fought), and the nonresponse (the combated). The principle: the statistics trusted — the independent, the confidential, the methodological.
how_it_works: Enumerate censuses, survey continuously, link admin data, disseminate impartially, protect confidentiality.

title: Grant-Making by Government
description: Government grants — the distributed funds — are made: the authorization (the legislated — the appropriated), the design (the objectives — the clear; the criteria — the published; the formula vs competitive — the chosen), the solicitation (the announced — the widely; the assisted — the applicants), the review (the merit — the peer; the fair — the documented), the award (the announced — the transparently), the management (the monitored — the supported; the reported — the accountably), and the evaluation (the assessed — the learned). The disciplines: the fairness (the competed), the simplicity (the burden — the proportionate), and the learning (the evaluated). The pathologies: the earmarked (the directed — the undebated), the captured (the favored), and the burdensome (the small grantees — the crushed). The principle: the public funds granted — the fairly, the simply, the accountably.
how_it_works: Design with clear criteria, solicit widely, review on merit, manage supportively, evaluate.

title: The Treaty-Making Workflow
description: Treaty-making — the international law workflow — runs: the negotiation (the mandated — the instructed; the conducted — the confidentially where needed), the signature (the authenticated — the politically), the ratification (the domestic — the legislatures’; the supermajority — the where required), the implementation (the legislated — the monist automatic; the dualist enacted), the compliance (the monitored — the reported; the disputed — the adjudicated), and the withdrawal (the provided — the executed lawfully). The disciplines: the democratic (the legislatures’ role — the respected), the pacta sunt servanda (the honored), and the transparency (the published — the registered with the UN). The principle: the treaties made and kept — the negotiated professionally, the ratified democratically, the honored reliably.
how_it_works: Negotiate with mandate, sign, ratify domestically, implement, comply, register.

title: Intelligence Workflows (Oversight Focus)
description: Intelligence — the secret state — is governed: the tasking (the requirements — the policymakers’; the prioritized), the collection (the lawful — the authorized; the minimized — the proportionate), the analysis (the objective — the politicization-resisted; the dissent — the preserved), the dissemination (the need-to-know — the timely), and the oversight (the legislative — the cleared committees; the judicial — the warrants; the executive — the inspectors). The disciplines: the legality (the chartered — the complied), the objectivity (the truth — the to power), and the accountability (the abuses — the investigated; the whistleblowers — the protected). The principle: the intelligence serves the democracy — the lawful, the objective, the overseen.
how_it_works: Task lawfully, collect proportionately, analyze objectively, disseminate timely, oversee robustly.

title: The Pardon and Clemency Workflow
description: Clemency — the merciful power — is exercised: the application (the petitioned — the accessible), the review (the investigated — the DOJ pardon attorney model; the criteria — the published), the recommendation (the advised — the transparently), the decision (the executive’s — the reasoned; the published), and the follow-up (the reintegrated — the supported). The disciplines: the regularity (the systematic — the not the arbitrary), the fairness (the equal — the connected not the favored), and the transparency (the reasoned — the published). The pathologies: the last-minute (the rushed — the unvetted), and the corrupt (the sold — the prosecuted). The principle: the mercy exercised justly — the regularly, the fairly, the transparently.
how_it_works: Petition accessibly, investigate systematically, recommend transparently, decide with reasons.

title: Performance Budgeting
description: Performance budgeting — the outcomes-informed — links: the plans (the strategic — the agency’s; the objectives), the measures (the outcomes — the tracked), the budget (the informed — the not the determined; the presented — the with performance), the review (the legislative — the questioning; the executive — the managing), and the learning (the evaluated — the reallocated). The variants: the presentational (the informed), the performance-informed (the loosely linked), and the direct (the formula — the tightly; the rare). The disciplines: the measures (the meaningful — the few), the honesty (the attributed — the carefully), and the use (the managing — the not the punishing). The principle: the budgets informed by performance — the measured meaningfully, the linked loosely, the managed for learning.
key_points: Strategic plans linked to budget requests
how_it_works: Plan strategically, measure outcomes, present with budget, review legislatively, learn and reallocate.

title: Zero-Based Budgeting
description: Zero-based budgeting (ZBB) — the justify-everything — requires: the decision packages (the activities — the described; the costed; the ranked), the ranking (the prioritized — the funded to the cut line), and the review (the questioned — the every cycle or periodic). The uses: the periodic (the every 5 years — the deep; the Carter’s federal attempt), and the targeted (the programs — the questioned). The virtues: the scrutiny (the base — the questioned), and the prioritization (the explicit). The vices: the burden (the enormous — the annual), the gaming (the ranked — the strategically), and the politics (the cut line — the moved). The principle: the ZBB used periodically and targeted — the base questioned sometimes, the burden managed.
how_it_works: Package activities, rank by priority, fund to cut line, review periodically.

title: The Regulatory Lookback
description: Retrospective review — the regulatory lookback — assesses: the inventory (the rules — the listed), the review (the outdated — the identified; the burdensome — the measured; the ineffective — the evidenced), the reform (the simplified — the repealed; the modernized), and the institutionalization (the periodic — the required; the sunsets — the considered). The models: the US (the executive orders — the periodic), and the EU (the REFIT — the fitness checks). The disciplines: the evidence (the measured — the actual vs estimated), the participation (the affected — the heard), and the action (the reformed — the actually). The principle: the rules reviewed retrospectively — the inventoried, the evidenced, the reformed.
how_it_works: Inventory rules, measure actual impacts, hear affected, simplify or repeal, institutionalize periodic review.

title: The Public Consultation Workflow
description: Public consultation — the democratic input — runs: the design (the questions — the genuine; the scope — the clear; the accessible — the multiple channels), the outreach (the affected — the targeted; the underheard — the sought), the deliberation (the informed — the materials; the facilitated — the respectful), the analysis (the considered — the genuinely; the reported — the what-we-heard), and the response (the answered — the government’s; the influenced — the visibly). The standards: the genuine (the open questions — the not the decided), the inclusive (the sought — the underheard), and the accountable (the responded — the explained). The failures: the sham (the decided — the consulted), and the unheard (the collected — the ignored). The principle: the consulted public influences — the genuinely asked, the inclusively heard, the visibly answered.
how_it_works: Design genuine questions, outreach inclusively, deliberate informedly, analyze honestly, respond publicly.

title: The Interagency Process
description: Interagency coordination — the joined-up — runs: the lead (the designated — the accountable), the mechanisms (the committees — the NSC model; the task forces — the temporary; the liaisons — the embedded), the decisions (the cleared — the circulated; the disputed — the escalated), and the implementation (the assigned — the tracked). The disciplines: the clarity (the roles — the defined), the escalation (the timely — the decided), and the follow-through (the tracked). The failures: the stovepipes (the uncoordinated), and the lead-less (the nobody-in-charge). The principle: the agencies coordinated — the led clearly, the escalated timely, the followed-through.
how_it_works: Designate lead, establish mechanisms, clear decisions, escalate disputes, track implementation.

title: The State of Emergency Workflow
description: Emergency powers workflow — the bounded — runs: the trigger (the defined — the met; the declared — the transparently), the powers (the enumerated — the proportionate; the time-limited), the oversight (the legislative — the reviewing; the judicial — the checking), the communication (the public — the clear; the regular), and the termination (the sunset — the honored; the review — the after-actioned). The principle: the emergency governed — the declared transparently, the powered proportionately, the ended promptly.
how_it_works: Declare on trigger, exercise enumerated powers, communicate clearly, oversee, sunset, review.

title: The Honours System Workflow
description: Honours — the state’s recognition — are awarded: the nomination (the public’s — the open; the criteria — the published: the service, the achievement), the vetting (the independent — the committees; the probity — the checked), the decision (the advised — the head of state’s; the political — the insulated), and the ceremony (the invested — the celebrated). The disciplines: the merit (the earned — the not the purchased), the diversity (the reflective), and the integrity (the forfeited — the when disgraced). The principle: the honoured service recognized — the merit-based, the diverse, the integrity-guarded.
how_it_works: Nominate openly, vet independently, decide apolitically, celebrate, forfeit when disgraced.

title: The Workflow Audit (Government)
description: The government workflow audit — the process health — assesses: the legality (the authorized — the complied), the efficiency (the costed — the benchmarked), the effectiveness (the outcomes — the achieved), the fairness (the equal — the accessible), and the integrity (the corruption-free — the controlled). The method: the mapped (the as-is), the measured (the data), the benchmarked (the compared), and the reformed (the improved). The principle: the audited workflows improve — the legal, the efficient, the fair.
key_points: Assess legality, efficiency, effectiveness, fairness, integrity
how_it_works: Map workflows, measure performance, benchmark comparatively, reform, repeat.
